caption: The drawing depicts a single, high-backed armchair with prominent winged sides and scrolled armrests. The upholstery is a vibrant pinkish-red color, decorated with an intricate floral pattern in various shades of red and pink, accented by subtle greenish trim outlining the arms and edges of the chair. The seat, armrests, and backrest are all covered in the same patterned fabric. The legs and structural supports of the chair are rendered in a brown wooden tone, showing ornate carvings at the knees, with the front legs curving outward and ending in claw-and-ball feet. The legs are connected by simple wooden stretchers. The overall composition centers the chair against a plain, unadorned beige background with a rectangular border sketched around the image.
title: Easy Chair
